audit_scope: one-time substitute for unavailable Claude Opus 5 stage audit
blocking_findings: No interval-arithmetic certificate is computed for every 27-cell response component over a continuous topology cell and T=8; only finite source hulls or caller-supplied arrays exist.

A finite member hull can be passed through continuous_enclosures and is then marked continuous_certified/CERTIFIED; the existing test performs this promotion, so the Q7 certified gates would be unsound.
The specified certified seam/knot strata and induced 175-summary likelihood bounds are not implemented.

Topology splitting is not proven: there is no explicit periodic-seam/knot-cell test, and the Q7 topology key omits zero-scale subcell TSC weights, allowing distinct sigma=0 responses with the same target neighborhood to merge.
The 23-direction contract accepts arbitrary rank-23 arrays but does not load, hash, or compare the frozen state-mass/latent/bias basis against a Q1 reference.
Q7 has no first-class runtime provenance guard; Q1 SHA protection is only transitive through importing Q6.
non_blocking_findings: Default evaluation falls back sourcewise and matches the Q1 oracle in the unit test without clipping or tolerance relaxation.
Representative fields are checked finite, non-negative and mass-conserving; enclosure arrays themselves are not conservation-checked.
The host-memory estimate undercounts contracts and temporaries and raises instead of reporting the planned overflow fraction.
Fixture generator hashes are deterministic and held-out data are not referenced; the seven-family sweep was not independently run during this audit.
No forbidden GPFS, Slurm, JAX, posterior, IC, PM/HOP/RAMSES or zoom path was found.
required_fixes_before_q7_2: Implement machine-checked interval arithmetic (or equivalent) for every response component over each topology cell and T=8; caller arrays alone must never establish certification.
Keep finite member hulls finite_source_set only and remove/invert the test that promotes them to continuous certificates.
Retain sourcewise overflow as the only fallback and prohibit allow_uncertified_finite_enclosure in Q7.2.

Add deterministic tests for knot/stencil, translated-cell, periodic-seam, sliver on/off, clip-mask, and sigma=0 versus near-zero separation; fix zero-scale topology keys to include the subcell TSC response.
Wire and hash the frozen 23 state-mass/latent/bias directions and certify/measure their Q1 mass-gather errors.
Add a Q7-local runtime SHA guard for frozen Q1 and Q6 sources.
Expose certified value L1/Linf, seam/knot strata and induced 175-summary bounds separately from measured values.
science_disposition: Q7.1 implementation remains development-only; no posterior, IC, PM/HOP, zoom or <=0.3 cMpc/h claim is authorized.
